foundation.q: What is 2 1/2 - 3/4? Give your answer as a fraction or mixed number.
foundation.work: Check regrouping or conversion to improper fractions (10/4 - 3/4). Common error: 1 1/4 or 2 1/4.

foundation.q: A shirt costs $60. It is discounted by 25%. What is the new price in dollars?
foundation.work: Check 25% of 60 = 15, then subtract. Common error: answering 15.

foundation.q: Two angles of a triangle are 52 and 63 degrees. What is the third angle, in degrees?
foundation.work: Angle sum is 180. Common error: using 360 or arithmetic slip.

foundation.q: A car travels 135 km in 1 hour 30 minutes. What is its average speed in km per hour?
foundation.work: Child must convert 1 h 30 min to 1.5 h. Common error: 135 / 1.30 or 135 / 30.

core.q: A number machine doubles the input and then adds 5. The output is 31. What was the input?
core.work: Look for working backwards (31 - 5, then halve). Common error: halving first or giving 26.

core.q: How many prime numbers are there between 30 and 50?
core.work: Primes are 31, 37, 41, 43, 47. Common errors: including 39 or 49, or counting 1.

core.q: The temperature is -4 degrees C at night. It rises by 9 degrees by noon, then falls by 12 degrees by evening. What is the evening temperature in degrees C?
core.work: Check number line use: -4 + 9 = 5, 5 - 12 = -7. Common error: answering 7.

core.q: A bag has 4 red, 3 blue and 5 green marbles. One marble is picked at random. What is the probability it is NOT green? Give a fraction in simplest form.
core.work: Total is 12, not green is 7. Common error: 5/12, or 7/5 (comparing to green).

core.q: The mean of 5 numbers is 12. Four of the numbers are 8, 10, 15 and 11. What is the fifth number?
core.work: Total must be 60; the four add to 44. Common error: finding the mean of the four numbers.

core.q: It is 10 o'clock now on a 12-hour clock. What time will it be 17 hours later? Give the hour only.
core.work: 10 + 17 = 27, 27 - 24 = 3 (or 17 mod 12 = 5, then 10 + 5 = 15 -> 3). Common error: answering 27 or 5.

stretch.q: A robot faces North. It repeats this instruction 6 times: 'turn 90 degrees clockwise'. Which direction does it face at the end?
stretch.work: 6 x 90 = 540 = 360 + 180, so it ends facing the opposite way. Common error: East or West from miscounting turns; look for the child listing each turn.

stretch.q: Using the digits 1, 2, 3 and 4, with no digit used more than once, how many different 3-digit even numbers can be made?
stretch.work: Last digit 2 or 4 (2 ways), then 3 x 2 for the others. Common error: 24 (ignoring evenness) or listing incompletely.
